description: Builds an export plan. Pass `assets` as lines like `search-icon | 24x24 | icon | web, ios, android` or as a JSON array of {name, width, height, kind, platforms}. Kinds: icon, logo, illustration, photo, ui, background, favicon, app-icon, og-image, sprite. For each asset returns the recommended format (SVG for vector kinds, AVIF or WebP with JPEG fallback for photos, PNG for flat UI), web 1x to 3x sizes, iOS @2x and @3x, Android mdpi to xxxhdpi sizes (1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4 times), favicon and PWA sizes, adaptive icon geometry, the 1200x630 social card, and warnings for fractional or odd sizes. Rules of thumb that change over time; confirm against current platform docs. Computes sizes only and produces no files.

assets.description: Lines like `name | 24x24 | icon | web, ios`, or a JSON array.
